title.rendered: Sip & Spell – Sherwood Education Foundation (SEF) Fundraiser

content.rendered:
The Sherwood Education Foundation is
excited to announce the 2nd Annual Sip & Spell event has been
scheduled for February 8th, 2018 at the Sherwood Center for the
Performing Arts from 6:00-9:30.  This
fundraising event will feature a silent auction, dinner and local adult
celebrity spelling bee featuring teachers and community members.  Our very own kindergarten teacher, Katie
Goodman will be representing Middleton as a celebrity speller and our
Principal, Jon Wollmuth will be a judge. 
This is guaranteed to be a fun event that will benefit all of our
schools.  To order tickets click here.
